integrity.description: Verify the agent didn't just create empty files or placeholder text.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show actual data values in the CSVs (e.g., specific stop IDs like those found in the scenario) rather than generic 'stop1, stop2' labels.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually ran the SUMO simulation tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal logs showing 'sumo' or 'sumo-gui' commands being executed, or the SUMO GUI window active during the process.

integrity.description: Check that the underserved stops identified in the CSV match the stops included in the new route file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Cross-referencing the IDs in underserved_stops.csv with the 'busStop' references in acosta_new_bus_route.rou.xml.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The scenario contains 35 bus stops and 157 initial bus vehicles. Underserved stops are strictly defined as those with < 3 visits OR average headway > 1200 seconds. The new route file must include at least 2 new vehicles and cover at least 3 of the identified underserved stops. The final report must be located at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/transit_assessment_report.txt.
